final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(res.points) AS p, AVG(res.laps) AS l FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(p) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.name AS name, s1.p AS p, s1.l AS l, s1.p - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.p > s2.a) SELECT SUM(p), AVG(l), AVG(d) FROM s3
